# Exact package versions installed on the production server (pip freeze, 2026-11-10).
# CI installs requirements.txt WITH these constraints so tests run on what production runs:
# requirements.txt has open ranges (e.g. sqlalchemy>=2.0.0), and deploy.sh never upgrades
# an installed package, so without this CI would test newer libraries than production
# (SQLAlchemy 2.1 switches the default Postgres driver from psycopg2 to psycopg 3).
# Refresh after a deliberate upgrade on the server: .venv/bin/pip freeze | sort
